approval/risk:
### PAY-VELA
Pending payment. Policy requires the requesting and approving authority to originate from different accountable units.
- P1: requested_by [ACT-Q](#act-q)
- P2: assigned_approval_to [ACT-W](#act-w)

### ACT-Q
Requestor account. Raises purchase payments for one accountable unit.
- P3: authority_origin [UNIT-M](#unit-m)

### ACT-W
Named approval delegate. A distinct login. Authority follows its delegation, irrespective of login ID.
- P4: authority_origin [UNIT-M](#unit-m)

### UNIT-M
Accountable unit. Holds delegated spending authority.

### UNIT-N
Accountable unit. A separate accountable unit.
